name: Can drywall patches be done on textured walls, and how is the texture matched?

mainEntity.name: Can drywall patches be done on textured walls, and how is the texture matched?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, drywall patches can be done on textured walls. Matching the existing texture is a critical step for a seamless repair. After the drywall patch is smooth and dry, our team uses specialized techniques and tools, such as spray-on texture, brushes, or sponges, to replicate the original texture pattern. This can include orange peel, knockdown, or skip trowel finishes. Achieving a precise match often requires skill and experience to blend the new texture invisibly with the surrounding surface.
